1000/static_static.config_yaml:

diffusion: absorbing_state
backbone: dit
parameterization: subs
time_conditioning: false
T: 0
subs_masking: false
seed: 1
loader:
  global_batch_size: 4
  eval_global_batch_size: 4
  batch_size: 4
  eval_batch_size: 4
  num_workers: 0
  pin_memory: true
sampling:
  predictor: ddpm_cache
  crf_reveal: gated
  steps: 128
  noise_removal: true
  num_sample_batches: 2
  num_sample_log: 2
  semi_ar: false
  stride_length: 1
  num_strides: 1
training:
  ema: 0
  antithetic_sampling: true
  importance_sampling: false
  sampling_eps: 0.001
  change_of_variables: false
eval:
  checkpoint_path: ''
  adapter_checkpoint: ''
  adapter_sha256: ''
  adapter_manifest: ''
  adapter_manifest_sha256: ''
  disable_ema: false
  compute_generative_perplexity: false
  perplexity_batch_size: 8
  compute_perplexity_on_sanity: false
  gen_ppl_eval_model_name_or_path: gpt2-large
  generate_samples: false
  structured_mask_rate: null
  corruption_seed: null
  conditional_records:
    enabled: false
    schema_version: 1
    support_candidate_ks: []
    protocol_id: null
    job_id: null
    arm: null
    train_seed: null
optim:
  weight_decay: 0
  lr: 0.0003
  beta1: 0.9
  beta2: 0.999
  eps: 1.0e-08
trainer:
  _target_: lightning.Trainer
  accelerator: cuda
  num_nodes: 1
  devices: 1
  accumulate_grad_batches: ${div_up:${loader.global_batch_size}, ${eval:${trainer.devices}
    * ${loader.batch_size} * ${trainer.num_nodes}}}
  gradient_clip_val: 1.0
  precision: bf16
  num_sanity_val_steps: 0
  max_steps: 1000
  log_every_n_steps: 10
  limit_train_batches: 1.0
  limit_val_batches: 32
  val_check_interval: 500
wandb: null
checkpointing:
  save_dir: /u401/n23zhang/mdlm_data/tree_mdlm_cache/runs/four_arm_s001_k128/static_static
  resume_from_ckpt: false
  resume_ckpt_path: ${.save_dir}/checkpoints/last.ckpt
callbacks:
  checkpoint_every_n_steps:
    _target_: lightning.pytorch.callbacks.ModelCheckpoint
    save_top_k: -1
    save_last: true
    dirpath: ${checkpointing.save_dir}/checkpoints
    verbose: true
    auto_insert_metric_name: false
    every_n_train_steps: 500
  checkpoint_monitor:
    _target_: lightning.pytorch.callbacks.ModelCheckpoint
    monitor: ${oc.select:model.monitor_metric,val/nll}
    mode: min
    save_top_k: 1
    save_last: false
    dirpath: ${checkpointing.save_dir}/checkpoints
    filename: best
    auto_insert_metric_name: false
    verbose: true
  learning_rate_monitor:
    _target_: lightning.pytorch.callbacks.LearningRateMonitor
    logging_interval: step
data:
  train: openwebtext-train-pinned
  valid: wikitext103-pinned
  tokenizer_name_or_path: openai-community/gpt2
  tokenizer_revision: 607a30d783dfa663caf39e06633721c8d4cfcd7e
  cache_dir: /u401/n23zhang/mdlm_data/tree_mdlm_cache/huggingface
  wrap: true
  streaming: true
  shuffle_validation: false
  require_pinned_provenance: true
  require_disjoint_train_valid_windows: false
  train_dataset_name_or_path: Skylion007/openwebtext
  train_dataset_config_name: plain_text
  train_source_split: train
  train_revision: 79d93d786212f7344586290adb811d4ae6a1762c
  train_expected_source_num_rows: 8013769
  train_source_window:
  - 0
  - 7913769
  train_text_field: text
  train_document_boundary_mode: concatenate
  train_trust_remote_code: false
  valid_dataset_name_or_path: Salesforce/wikitext
  valid_dataset_config_name: wikitext-103-raw-v1
  valid_source_split: validation
  valid_revision: b08601e04326c79dfdd32d625aee71d232d685c3
  valid_expected_source_num_rows: 3760
  valid_source_window: null
  valid_text_field: text
  valid_document_boundary_mode: wikitext_articles
  valid_trust_remote_code: false
model:
  name: contextual-forest-small
  type: ddit
  monitor_metric: val/structured/conditional_nll_per_masked_token
  hidden_size: 768
  cond_dim: 128
  length: 1024
  n_blocks: 12
  n_heads: 12
  scale_by_sigma: true
  dropout: 0.1
  tie_word_embeddings: false
  structured_decoder:
    enabled: true
    top_k: 128
    rank: 16
    time_embed_dim: 64
    topology_dim: 128
    local_window: 2
    num_anchor_slots: 16
    contextual_neighbors: 4
    component_size_cap: 32
    topology_mode: fixed
    factor_mode: fixed
    independent_mode: false
    min_edge_score: null
    fixed_edges: null
    fixed_edge_path: null
    training:
      objective_name: conditional_denoising_nll_not_diffusion_elbo
      backbone_mode: frozen
      backbone_checkpoint: /u401/n23zhang/mdlm_data/tree_mdlm_cache/checkpoints/mdlm-owt-backbone.pt
      require_pretrained_backbone: true
      strict_backbone_checkpoint: true
      use_ema_backbone: false
      deterministic_backbone: true
      head_lr: 0.0003
      backbone_lr_multiplier: 0.0
      structured_nll_weight: 1.0
      factorized_aux_weight: 0.0
      topology_strategy: gold_reveal_influence
      topology_weight: 0.0
      topology_temperature: 0.25
      topology_minimum_choices: 2
      topology_edge_weight: 1.0
      topology_anchor_weight: 0.25
      topology_slot_weight: 0.25
      topology_on_validation: false
    sampling:
      mode: factorized
strategy:
  _target_: lightning.pytorch.strategies.DDPStrategy
  find_unused_parameters: true
noise:
  type: loglinear
  sigma_min: 0.0001
  sigma_max: 20
lr_scheduler:
  _target_: transformers.get_constant_schedule_with_warmup
  num_warmup_steps: 50
